security.note: No own res.groups; 3 ir.model.access entries (mailing.sms.test, sms.tracker, phone.blacklist.remove) reuse mass_mailing.group_mass_mailing_user.

views.note: Adds SMS form/list variants for mailing.mailing + mailing.trace, an SMS mailing-list view, portal templates, and SMS A/B campaign columns; reuses the parent mass_mailing pivot/graph statistics views.

behavioral_notes.observation: mass_mailing's queue cron drives both channels: action_put_in_queue -> ir_cron_mass_mailing_queue -> _process_mass_mailing_queue -> _action_send_mail. This module overrides _action_send_mail to split off mailing_type=='sms' records and route them to action_send_sms, leaving the email branch to super(). action_send_sms calls _get_remaining_recipients(), then creates an sms.composer in composition_mode='mass' (via _send_sms_get_composer_values, carrying body_plaintext, sms_template_id, mailing_id, mass_force_send, use_exclusion_list) and calls composer._action_send_sms(). So an SMS mailing reuses the email mailing state machine and audience computation but emits sms.sms rows instead of mail.mail.

behavioral_notes.element: sms.composer mass override -> sms.sms queue + IAP credit consumption
behavioral_notes.observation: The inherited sms.composer._action_send_sms_mass builds per-recipient sms.sms via _prepare_mass_sms; the override _prepare_mass_sms_values nests a mailing.trace (trace_type='sms', sms_code, sms_number, an sms.tracker keyed by sms.uuid) directly into each sms.sms create, and _update_body_short_links rewrites /r/<code> links to /r/<code>/s/<sms_id>. If sms_force_send the rows are sent inline via sms.sms.send(); otherwise the sms.sms create() triggers sms.ir_cron_sms_scheduler_action, whose _process_queue batch-sends (sms.session.batch.size, default 500) through SmsApi._send_sms_batch -> iap_jsonrpc POST to https://sms.api.odoo.com (this is where IAP SMS credits are consumed). Insufficient credit / unregistered account map back to failure_type sms_credit / sms_acc, surfaced on the mailing via _compute_sms_has_iap_failure (buy-credits / register-account banners).

behavioral_notes.element: mailing.trace per-recipient tracking + click/bounce via sms.tracker (mailing_trace.py, sms_tracker.py, controllers/main.py)
behavioral_notes.observation: Each recipient gets one mailing.trace (sms_code random 3-char obfuscator, sms_number, sms_id_int loose link because the sms.sms can be GC'd independently). Delivery state flows IAP-side through sms.tracker._action_update_from_sms_state / _action_update_from_provider_error, whose overrides call _update_sms_traces (mapping sms state -> trace_status via SMS_STATE_TO_TRACE_STATUS, monotonic guard against regressing status) and _update_sms_mailings (flips the mailing to 'sending' on process, then to 'done' once no trace is still in 'process'). Click tracking: the public /r/<code>/s/<sms_id_int> route resolves the trace by sms_id_int and calls link.tracker.click.add_click(mailing_trace_id=...) before a 301 to the real URL. Pre-send cancellations (blacklist/duplicate/optout) are persisted as 'cancel' traces by _filter_out_and_handle_revoked_sms_values before any IAP call.

behavioral_notes.element: Public unsubscribe / mailing-list opt-out + phone blacklist (controllers/main.py)
behavioral_notes.observation: When sms_allow_unsubscribe is on, each body gets a 'STOP SMS: <base>/sms/<mailing_id>/<trace_code>' link (sms.composer._get_unsubscribe_info/_get_unsubscribe_url). /sms/<mailing_id>/<trace_code> (blacklist_page) validates the trio code/mailing/number, geoip-sanitizes the entered number to E164, then redirects to /sms/<mailing_id>/unsubscribe/<trace_code> (blacklist_number). There the logic branches: if the mailing targeted contact_list_ids it writes opt_out=True on matching mailing.subscription rows (list-level opt-out, leaving the contact opted-in on other lists); otherwise (document/blacklist mode) it adds the sanitized number to phone.blacklist via add() and logs the source mailing. Opt-out, void in the base sms module, is implemented here via _get_optout_record_ids -> mailing._get_opt_out_list_sms and mailing.list._mailing_get_opt_out_list_sms (opt-out only if opted-out on every involved list).

behavioral_notes.element: SMS A/B testing + de-duplication seen-list (mailing_mailing.py, utm.py)
behavioral_notes.observation: SMS variants share a utm.campaign with ab_testing_sms_winner_selection (default clicks_ratio); _get_ab_testing_siblings_mailings restricts siblings to campaign.mailing_sms_ids, and the inherited campaign winner cron sends the SMS winner at 100%. _get_seen_list_sms runs a raw SQL JOIN of mailing_trace against the target table's phone fields (phone_sanitized for mail.thread.phone models, else the model's phone fields or a res.partner phone) to exclude numbers already reached by the same mailing, feeding sms.composer._get_done_record_ids. action_retry_failed_sms deletes errored sms.sms + their traces and re-queues.

Single JS file fields_sms_widget.js patches the base sms module's SmsWidget.prototype (no own OWL component / registry add). On mailing.mailing records it calls get_sms_link_replacements_placeholders over ORM to learn the character length the link-tracker short URL and the 'STOP SMS' opt-out link will occupy, then corrects the live SMS character/segment counter (nbrChar / nbrCharExplanation / _getValueForSmsCounts) so the GSM-160 segment estimate accounts for tracked-link and opt-out expansion. Bundles: web.assets_backend, web.assets_tests.

0 raw http_call_sites and no third-party SDK imports in this module; all SMS delivery is delegated to the base sms module's IAP layer (iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc -> https://sms.api.odoo.com), with the inbound /sms/status delivery-report webhook (defined in sms) updating sms.tracker -> mailing.trace. The manifest exposes the product page https://www.odoo.com/app/sms-marketing. uses_api_keys=false: auth is the IAP account_token + database.uuid, not a customer-held API key.

it_architecture.application: mass_mailing_sms (SMS Marketing application component - an SMS broadcast channel layered on the Email Marketing engine via the sms/IAP gateway)
logical_data_erm: mailing.mailing -> utm.campaign (SMS A/B variants: mailing_sms_ids / ab_testing_sms_winner_selection)
information_flows: side-effect: action_put_in_queue -> ir_cron_mass_mailing_queue -> _action_send_mail (override) -> action_send_sms -> sms.composer(mass) -> sms.sms rows + nested mailing.trace
side-effect: sms.sms create -> sms.ir_cron_sms_scheduler_action -> _process_queue -> SmsApi._send_sms_batch -> IAP https://sms.api.odoo.com (consumes SMS credits)

external_integrations.notes: No own SDK/HTTP. SMS delivery and credit consumption go through the base sms module's IAP layer (iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc -> sms.api.odoo.com); inbound /sms/status webhook (sms module) feeds delivery status back into sms.tracker -> mailing.trace. Auth = IAP account_token + database.uuid (uses_api_keys=false).

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: mass_mailing_sms is the SMS channel of the mass_mailing value network and inherits its classification: a value-network mediating activity (Stabell & Fjeldstad) that connects the firm to a large audience at scale, brokering the relationship through mediating infrastructure (mailing lists/subscriptions, the SMS/IAP gateway, UTM campaigns, per-recipient delivery/click/bounce tracking). It reuses mass_mailing.mailing.mailing/mailing.trace and the whole queue+statistics machinery, only swapping the delivery substrate from SMTP/mail.mail to sms.sms over Odoo IAP. Per the network model the primary activities are network promotion & contract management (audience selection, opt-out/blacklist), service provisioning (queued SMS send), and infrastructure operation (IAP credits, link tracking) - broadcasting to a contact network rather than transforming inputs (chain) or solving a client problem (shop). It maps to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.4 Develop and manage marketing communications - the SMS execution channel). It is classified primary (not support like the base sms gateway) because here SMS is the marketing campaign itself, not a cross-cutting notification channel: it adds a mailing_type='sms', a marketing audience/opt-out model, and campaign A/B testing on top of the gateway.

standard_capabilities: SMS mailings as a mailing_type on the Email Marketing engine (shared lists, campaigns, scheduling, statistics)
SMS body editing with templates and a live character/segment counter aware of tracked links + opt-out text
queued/force send of sms.sms through the sms module's IAP gateway with credit checks
per-recipient delivery + click + bounce/failure tracking into mailing.trace (sms.tracker bridge, /r/<code>/s/<sms_id> click route)
public 'STOP SMS' unsubscribe -> mailing-list opt-out (mailing.subscription) or phone.blacklist
blacklist / duplicate / opt-out / invalid-number pre-send suppression with explicit failure_type codes
SMS A/B testing with automatic winner selection on a shared utm.campaign
buy-credits / register-IAP-account banners and retry-failed-SMS action
typical_fits: promotional / reminder SMS blasts to mailing lists
targeted SMS on any phone-bearing mailing model via domain filters
campaign-level SMS A/B test then broadcast the winner
SMS + email multichannel campaigns sharing one utm.campaign and statistics dashboard
common_gaps: non-Odoo SMS provider requires subclassing the base SmsApi (delivery is hard-wired to Odoo IAP)
two-way / inbound SMS (replies) not modeled - delivery is one-way + status webhook only
no SMS send-time throttling/scheduling UI beyond the queue cron batch size
advanced drip / multi-step SMS journeys belong to marketing_automation, not this module
IAP credits, country support, and sender registration depend on external Odoo service state
